$description: Lumen v0.13 — EXPRESSIVE mode rebind set. Opt-in via `[data-mode='expressive']` scope on a container. NEVER replaces components or primitives — only rebinds a small set of mode-aware semantic tokens (surface.hero / surface.canvas-ambient / surface.atmosphere / motion.atmosphere) to their expressive values (mesh recipes + ambient gradients + animated mesh-drift). Used on landing surfaces, marketing pages, AI surfaces (chat / agents / generation), onboarding flows, empty states, hero panels. The accent (`#00FA8A`), type (Satoshi), grid (4-pt base), focus rings, and the WCAG 2.2 AA contract are UNCHANGED across modes — only ambient atmosphere differs. The runtime CSS scoping in dist/css/lumen.scoping.css adds the @property registrations + @keyframes mesh-drift + @media reduced-{motion,transparency} fallback + @supports not (backdrop-filter) fallback. Restrained mode opts out — surface.hero collapses back to solid canvas, mesh-drift freezes.

name.$description: v0.13 — the opt-in mode. NEVER the default; restrained is the default.

atmosphere.$description: Expressive surfaces boost atmospheric opacity to 10–14% — aurora ambient glow, named mesh recipe, optional grain at 8%. Honours prefers-reduced-motion (mesh-drift freeze) AND prefers-reduced-transparency (atmosphere collapses to opaque tint).

glass-policy.$description: Expressive allows blur radius up to 28px on hero shells. Still NEVER on data table / row / cell. Hero device frame, hero overlay, navigation glass are all in-scope.

motion-policy.$description: Aurora fades, mesh drifts, grain shimmers — all gated on prefers-reduced-motion. Default easing is still decelerate; atmospheric loops use linear.

canvas.$description: Expressive mode: page canvas stays SOLID obsidian. Mesh goes on surface.hero, not page canvas. Master doc Phase 1 explicit: 'still solid; mesh goes on hero/atmosphere, not page canvas.'

hero.$description: Expressive hero = full aurora-spring mesh recipe. The three-blob radial atmosphere (deep teal + Spring Green + deep indigo). Layered over obsidian.800 as the fallback. Master doc Phase 1: 'surface.hero → {mesh.aurora-spring} (full mesh recipe)'.

canvas-ambient.$description: Expressive page canvas-ambient = subtle radial gradient (obsidian.900 center → obsidian.800 edges). A faint lit-from-within feel without committing to a mesh. Master doc Phase 1: 'surface.canvas-ambient → {gradient.canvas-ambient} (subtle radial)'.

atmosphere.$description: Expressive atmospheric overlay — Spring Green at 8% alpha (was 12% in Phase 1 draft; lowered to clear the body-tier contrast gate for text rendered on mesh). Composes on hero / panel chrome to signal expressive scope without competing with content.

Expressive mode: animates the mesh stop positions via @property + @keyframes mesh-drift (defined in dist/css/lumen.scoping.css). 24s loop, ease-in-out, infinite, alternate. Stops drift 8–12% over the cycle. Gated on prefers-reduced-motion → 'none'.

overlay.$description: Expressive mode: 8% SVG feTurbulence grain overlay on hero surfaces. Dithers gradient banding. Restrained mode: no overlay (the .noise-overlay element resolves to opacity 0).
